codex-perf-hooks.decision: Require every ON window to pass coverage/current-frame/energy gates. Derive CPU and GPU tolerances from repeated OFF windows; claim a saving only if its interval excludes zero. Do not sum rank 2 and rank 3 estimates into presented-frame savings.

codex-perf-submit2.hypothesis: Batch compatible host work without changing game submit entries, descriptor contents, geometry, energy or completion ownership.

predicted.cpu_basis: Ranks 6 and 7 each estimate 0 to 0.1 ms, overlap and are unmeasured. Zero saving is credible. No positive target or sum is asserted.
predicted.gpu_basis: Same GPU command streams except eligible private completion signal shares a driver call. No pass saving predicted; compare to OFF repeat noise.
predicted.omm_ineligible_batches: No reduction. Extension chains, protected flags, invalid generations and foreign queues keep the original path.

plan.preset: Ultra with all qualified keys unchanged; diagnostics build and cpu_timing=1
plan.note: The four 90 s windows take about 6 minutes per save, exceeding the usual 2-5 minute target to satisfy per-window stats and pacing minima. Use one launch per save, repeat the same static/pan/rotation route. Do not shorten required windows to fit a time target.
plan.baseline_noise: Derive uncertainty and energy/GPU tolerances from matching OFF repeats in the same session. If savings include zero, report no proven gain.
